_what: One real OpenCode request per surface (three of them since 7.13.0), recorded through a local forward proxy and reduced to the parts a contract test may assert.
_client: responses: opencode-ai@1.18.31 (2026-09-19); chat_completions and messages: opencode-ai@1.18.30 (2026-09-11)
_how: The real OpenCode CLI was driven in a scratch HOME/XDG tree with provider.opencode.options.baseURL pointed at a recording proxy on 127.0.0.1; the credential came from the environment and was never written to the user's own OpenCode config. The responses capture answered 200 text/event-stream. The chat-completions capture is the same model, key and headers sent to the other endpoint minutes later by a scripted probe, which answered 500.
_retake_when: Any opencode-ai major, or whenever the OpenCode surface work is touched. A fixture pins MCC to ONE observation: it catches MCC drifting away from OpenCode, never OpenCode drifting away from the fixture.
_not_asserted: Authorization, per-call ids (x-opencode-request, x-opencode-session), the x-stainless-* family MCC's SDK adds, and transport headers. The first is a secret, the second changes every call, the third carries the runner's Python and OS versions and fails on a different machine, and the fourth is the HTTP client's business.

responses._project_header_shape: 40 lowercase hex -- the root commit of the working directory's repository; the literal 'global' only when the directory is not one

sub_request._what: The title sub-request the same run made first. It carries NO tools key, no tool_choice and no prompt_cache_key -- which is why the free tier's catalogue classifier refuses OpenCode's own title and compaction subagents (anomalyco/opencode#49592, #49723), and why MCC does not invent a catalogue for a tool-less request either.

messages._answered: HTTP 401 'Model minimax-m3-free is not supported' -- the endpoint exists and answers in Anthropic's own error shape; the model that was on this surface has been withdrawn, which is why no live model can exercise it.
messages._credential: The capture carries the credential TWICE, as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' and as 'x-api-key: <key>', alongside 'anthropic-version'. The gateway authenticates like itself and the protocol behind it authenticates like Anthropic. Neither value is recorded here.

_retaken_at: 2026-09-19 -- the responses surface only, from opencode-ai@1.18.31, for the free-tier tool-catalogue work. The chat_completions and messages rows are still the 2026-09-11 capture of 1.18.30 and say so in _client.
